Sample learner
Subject chunein
Library kholein aur ek subject chunein.
Yahan batch ke subjects milte hain. Practice mein sirf sample lectures hain.
Apna lecture dhoondhein
Lecture dhoondhne ke liye week selector use karein.
Week ya page badal kar lectures dekhein. Locked lectures apni date par khulte hain.
Lecture poora karein
Lecture dekhne ke baad circle par tap karein.
Sample lecture ab done hai. Asli tracker mein dobara tap karke mark hata sakte hain.
Revision plan karein
Revision ki date ke liye Plan revision par tap karein.
Poore lecture ki revision date rakh sakte hain. Revision ke baad Revision done chunein. Practice mein kuch schedule nahi hota.
Apna study plan chunein
Apne plan ke liye Official ya Personal chunein.
Official batch schedule follow karta hai. Personal mein apni watch dates rakh sakte hain. Asli setting nahi badlegi.
Calendar dekhein
Classes aur revision dekhne ke liye Calendar kholein.
Kisi din par tap karke uska kaam dekhein. Asli calendar mein saved plans dikhte hain.
Apni progress dekhein
Poore lectures dekhne ke liye Progress kholein.
Har subject mein done aur baaki lectures dekhein. Yahan sabhi counts samples hain.
Habit jodein
Shuru karne ke liye + New Habit par tap karein.
Ek chhoti routine chunein jo aap repeat karna chahte hain. Practice kuch save nahi karti.
Habit ka naam rakhein
Habit ka chhota naam likhein.
Saaf naam se daily checklist aasaan hoti hai. Jaise, 10 minute padhna.
Repeat days chunein
Every day ya Specific days chunein, phir Create Habit dabayein.
Habit chune hue din dikhegi. Practice sirf preview dikhati hai.
Aaj ka kaam poora karein
Kaam poora hone par check button dabayein.
Sample habit aaj complete hai. Asli list mein dobara tap karke mark hata sakte hain.
Apna week dekhein
Har din dekhne ke liye Weekly kholein.
Weekly view mein scheduled days aur completed habits dikhte hain. Doosre weeks bhi dekh sakte hain.
Apna month dekhein
Monthly record ke liye Month kholein.
Poore month ki progress dekhein. Yahan marks sirf samples hain.
Habit badlein
Naam ya repeat days badalne ke liye pencil dabayein.
Save Changes se habit update hoti hai. Archive active list se hatata hai. Permanent delete records hata deta hai. Practice mein kuch nahi badlega.
Ek space chunein
Posts dekhne ke liye Academic ya Reflective chunein.
Academic padhai aur Reflective thoughts ke liye hai. Share karne se pehle guidelines padhein.
Post shuru karein
Post likhne ke liye + dabayein.
Community se sawaal ya thought share karein. Practice mein kuch publish nahi hota.
Apni post likhein
Apna sawaal ya thought yahan likhein.
Saaf aur respect se likhein. Yeh sample hai, doosre log ise nahi dekhenge.
Share karne ka space chunein
Space chunein aur share se pehle mera naam chhipaayein check karein.
Bina naam share karne ke liye mera naam chhipaayein on karein. Asli screen par ready hone par Share post dabayein.
Discussion mein judein
Post par like, reply ya save use karein.
Asli community mein likes aur replies doosron ko dikhte hain. Saved post phir milti hai. Practice kuch nahi bhejti.
Saved posts dhoondhein
Post dobara padhne ke liye Saved kholein.
Saved posts yahan milti hain. Zaroorat na ho toh saved mark hata dein.
Logon se judein
Chat requests ke liye Connections kholein.
Request accept hone ke baad chat shuru hoti hai. Premium ki zaroorat ho sakti hai. Practice koi request ya message nahi bhejti.
Session ka time chunein
Minutes chunne ke liye slider move karein.
Apni suvidha se chhota session chunein. Practice mein timer nahi chalta aur time record nahi hota.
Dhyan shuru karein
Ready hone par Play dabayein.
Play se session shuru hota hai. Next asli session shuru kiye bina running controls dikhata hai.
Zaroorat par rukein
Thoda rukne ke liye Pause dabayein.
Pause ke baad wahi session jaari rakhne ke liye Play dabayein. Practice mein timer ya sound nahi chalta.
Dobara shuru karein
Poore time par lautne ke liye Reset dabayein.
Timer aapke selected time par lautega. Practice meditation record nahi banati.
Breathing guidance chunein
Pattern ke liye Breathing techniques kholein.
Aaraamdayak pattern chunein. Inhale, hold aur exhale ke cues follow karein.
Session audio chunein
Audio library ke liye music icon dabayein.
Meditation ka sound chunein. Breathing sounds bhi milte hain. Practice audio nahi chalati ya save karti.
Quiet mode use karein
Audio mute karne ke liye speaker dabayein.
Asli session mein dobara tap se sound aayega. Mute sound rokta hai, Pause timer rokta hai.
